可使用中文或英文填写。 / Fill this out in Chinese or English.

## 解决的问题 / Problem and change

说明触发条件、原来的行为和修改后的行为。关联 Issue（如有）。

Describe the trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior. Link an Issue if applicable.

## 验证 / Validation

列出实际运行的命令、环境和结果；界面改动附截图。未运行的检查说明原因。

List commands actually run, environments and results. Include screenshots for UI changes and explain checks not run.

## 影响与限制 / Impact and limitations

说明兼容性、数据格式或部署影响，以及尚未验证的平台。没有影响时简要注明。

Note compatibility, data format or deployment effects and untested platforms. State briefly if none apply.

- [ ] 中英文文档和示例与行为一致。 / Both documentation languages and examples match the behavior.
- [ ] 提交中没有运行数据、凭据或客户应用。 / No runtime data, credentials or customer applications are included.
- [ ] 检查结果来自实际执行，未把协议测试记为原生 GUI 验证。 / Results reflect actual checks; protocol tests are not claimed as native GUI validation.
